seo.title: Frequently Asked Questions
seo.description: Common questions about pest control: safety, contracts, scorpions, termites, rodents and what happens on a visit.

sections.heading: Questions, answered.
sections.body: If yours is not here, call the office. Nobody is reading from a script.

items.question: Are your treatments safe for kids and pets?
items.answer: Yes. We use targeted baits and low-toxicity products placed where pests live, not where people and pets do. Most treated areas are fine to use again once dry, usually within **30 minutes**.

items.question: Do I have to sign a contract?
items.answer: No. One-time treatments are available, and protection plans can be cancelled any time without a fee.

items.question: What is a field report?
items.answer: A written summary we leave after every visit: what we found, where we treated, what we sealed, and what to watch for, with photos. It is how you know the work was actually done.

items.question: How soon can you come out?
items.answer: Usually the next business day, often the same day for wasps, bees and rodents in the living space.

items.question: What does it cost?
items.answer: A general pest treatment starts from $49 a visit on a plan. Termite and exclusion work is quoted after a free inspection, before anything starts.

items.question: Do you offer financing?
items.answer: Yes, on termite treatments and larger exclusion jobs. See the [financing page](/financing) for the current terms.

items.question: Can you get rid of scorpions completely?
items.answer: Nobody honest can promise zero. Sealing plus a regular perimeter treatment cuts indoor sightings dramatically, and we re-treat free if they get in.

items.question: Do I need to leave the house during treatment?
items.answer: Not for general pest, scorpion or rodent work. Bed bug heat treatments and some termite work need you out for part of the day; we tell you when you book.

sections.heading: Book a free inspection.
sections.body: A licensed technician, a written plan, no contract.
